categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 今天这批论文集中在世界模型与具身智能的表征、评测与持续学习，以及LLM的训练效率、成本控制与推理可解释性。

articles.title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
articles.zh: 更少解码器，更多编码器：从新视角合成中学习几何表征
articles.summary: 如果你在做3D表征或NeRF类工作，这篇提示你解码器可能一直是个拖累，砍掉反而学到更纯的几何特征
articles.author: Keerthi Kaashyap, Dennis Anthony 等
articles.body: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. This is not because of a lack of supervisory signal, but rather due to inconspicuous architectural choices: \textit{spatially expressive decoders} that dilute representational capabilities of the scene encoder, and \textit{low-level pixel-space targets} that hinder feature learning. We present SNAP, a self-supervised encoder-decoder transformer that addresses both through a pose-conditioned local decoder and a latent-space reconstruction objective. SNAP is task agnostic, and we show that it is competitive with special-purpose geometry-supervised methods. SNAP also performs competitively against self-supervised representations across five tasks: visual localization, pose estimation, point correspondence, depth estimation, and robot manipulation. Remarkably, SNAP's patch features exhibit emergent viewpoint invariance that approaches heavily supervised models despite lower compute and data budgets. Under camera shifts where standard 2D representations collapse, SNAP degrades more gracefully, revealing that restricting decoder expressivity actively prevents the suppression of transferable geometric structure. https://snap-nvs.github.io
articles.bodyZh: 这篇论文聊的是新视角合成（Novel View Synthesis, NVS）在几何表示学习（geometric representation learning）里到底能起什么作用。按理说，NVS 应该能推断出 3D 场景结构，从而学到可迁移的多视角几何表示。但现有的基于编码器的 NVS 方法，学出来的表示却不太行。问题不在于缺少监督信号，而在于一些不太起眼的架构选择：空间表达力很强的解码器，把场景编码器的表示能力给稀释了；还有低层次的像素空间目标，拖了特征学习的后腿。我们提出 SNAP——一个自监督的编码器-解码器 Transformer，通过姿态条件局部解码器（pose-conditioned local decoder）和潜空间重建目标（latent-space reconstruction objective）把这两个问题一起解决了。SNAP 不挑任务，我们证明它能跟专门做几何监督的方法打得有来有回。在五项任务上，SNAP 跟自监督表示方法比也很有竞争力：视觉定位、姿态估计、点对应、深度估计和机器人操作。更厉害的是，SNAP 的图像块特征（patch features）会自然涌现出视角不变性（viewpoint invariance）；虽然算力和数据预算都更低，却已经接近重度监督模型。当相机位置发生变化时，标准 2D 表示会崩掉，而 SNAP 退化得更平缓。这说明，限制解码器的表达力，反而能防止可迁移的几何结构被压没。 https://snap-nvs.github.io

articles.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
articles.zh: 4DCodeBench：面向动态场景逆图形学的Agent基准测试
articles.summary: 如果你在评估Agent能不能从视频反推3D动态场景的代码，这个基准能帮你看清它们离真正可用还差多远
articles.author: Ruihong Shen, Žiga Kovačič 等
articles.body: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by implementing abstractions such as physical simulations to reproduce complex behavior. To evaluate this capability, we curate a set of real-world videos and construct synthetic scenes spanning diverse physical phenomena, including deformation, fluid flow, and fracture. We perform extensive benchmarking of frontier models, finding that strong static reconstruction capabilities do not yet translate into reliable reconstruction of complex dynamics. 4DCodeBench provides a testbed for tracking progress toward agents that can interpret the dynamics of the world through code. Our benchmark is available at https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench
articles.bodyZh:
我们这回带来了一个叫 4DCodeBench 的东西，它是干什么用的呢？简单说，就是让 AI 智能体（agent）通过写代码的方式，把视频里的动态场景给还原出来，还原成能直接跑的图形程序。这其实就是所谓的“4D 逆向图形学”（4D inverse graphics）——给你一段视频，你得反推出它是怎么构成的、怎么动起来的。

那智能体具体要怎么做呢？它得把眼睛看到的画面，转换成一套简洁的表示方式，说清楚场景里有什么结构、这些东西又是怎么动、怎么变的。要做到这一点，它还得会玩抽象，比如自己实现一套物理模拟，用代码把那些复杂的行为给复现出来。

为了衡量它们到底有没有这个本事，我们专门收集了一批真实世界的视频，又合成了一批场景，覆盖了各种不同的物理现象，像形变（deformation）、流体流动（fluid flow）、还有断裂（fracture），都包含在内。

拿这些数据，我们对当前的一批前沿模型（frontier model）做了大规模的测试。结果发现啊，这些模型静态重建做得挺不错，但一碰到复杂的动态场景，就有点力不从心了——静态的那套本事，还没法顺顺当当地搬到动态还原上来。

所以 4DCodeBench 就像一块试金石，可以用来追踪这个领域的进展：看看我们离那种“能用代码看懂世界怎么动”的智能体还有多远。我们的基准测试已经放在 https://github.com/4DCodeBench/4DCodeBench 上了。

articles.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
articles.zh: 世界模型该遗忘什么？面向持续适应的分层保留策略
articles.summary: 如果你在训世界模型又怕它学新忘旧，这篇给出的不是"全记住"，而是分层决定该留该丢
articles.author: Nishit Anand, Ramani Duraiswami 等
articles.body: Continual learning treats degradation on previously seen data as evidence of failure, a convention inherited from settings with a stationary prediction target, where a correct label remains correct indefinitely. World models do not satisfy this condition. Their prediction target is the environment, which changes, so knowledge that was accurate when acquired may later become false, and discarding it is required behavior rather than a defect. Non-stationary ground truth is well studied in the concept drift literature and in the temporal factuality of language models, but has not been formulated for world models, which are distinctive in that they also encode knowledge that must never be revised. We argue that continual world models require retention stratified by invariance timescale, separating invariants such as physics and object permanence, which must never be revised, from instance-level facts that should be revised as soon as the environment changes. Standard forgetting metrics cannot distinguish a world model that has correctly revised outdated knowledge from one that has suffered catastrophic forgetting, and consequently rank a frozen model highest, while existing physical-reasoning benchmarks evaluate only frozen checkpoints. We propose differential retention, which reports invariant regression testing across the adaptation stream jointly with revision latency, without aggregation.
articles.bodyZh: 持续学习把在旧数据上的性能下降当作失败的证据，这个标准是从预测目标固定的场景沿袭下来的，在那类场景里，正确的标签永远正确。但世界模型不满足这个条件。它的预测目标是环境，而环境会变，所以学到的知识当时是对的，后来可能就错了，这时候丢掉旧知识是必须的行为，不是缺陷。非平稳的真值在概念漂移（concept drift）文献和语言模型的时间事实性研究中都有探讨，但还没有针对世界模型的形式化描述，而世界模型的特殊之处在于，它同时编码了永远不该被修改的知识。我们认为，持续世界模型需要按不变性时间尺度（invariance timescale）分层保留知识，把物理规律、客体永久性这类永远不该修改的不变量，和那些环境一变就该更新的实例级事实区分开。标准的遗忘指标没法区分一个正确更新了过时知识的世界模型和一个遭遇了灾难性遗忘的模型，结果反而把冻结的模型排到最高，而现有的物理推理基准也只评估冻结的检查点。我们提出差分保留（differential retention），它在整个适应流上联合报告不变量回归测试和修正延迟，不做聚合。

articles.title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
articles.zh: EyeRobot 2.0：无需腕部相机的主动凝视精准操作
articles.summary: 如果你做机器人抓取又嫌腕部相机难装难标定，这个方案用主动凝视替代，硬件成本直接砍一块
articles.author: Kush Hari, Justin Kerr 等
articles.body: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during task execution, which we accomplish hierarchically by first training a low-level gaze servoing policy conditioned on a goal object, then training a target selector which emits fixation goals based on task progress. Both modules are trained with RL on real-world data: the first is trained with a dense geometric reward and the second co-trains with the BC gripper policy which allows it to discover fixation sequences that can resemble a human's fixation sequence while performing the task. EyeRobot 2.0 further takes advantage of fixation by canonicalizing gripper information into a fixation-relative SE(3) frame, which compacts the size of the action distribution to learn. We collect teleoperation data for 7 real-world and 6 simulated tasks, and conduct over 1000 physical and 1800 simulated robot trials comparing EyeRobot 2.0 against passive stereo and ego + wrist camera policies trained on the same data. Removing wrist cameras is costly for standard policies: with only passive stereo, real-world success drops from 52% to 27%. EyeRobot 2.0 closes this gap with only stereo, outperforming passive stereo by 40% in real and 20% in sim. It matches ego + wrist policies when their wrist views are clear (69% vs. 64%), and more than doubles their success when grasped objects occlude the wrist cameras (48% vs. 22%)
articles.bodyZh: 受人类视觉启发，我们搞了一个框架，用主动注视 (active gaze) 让只用单个立体相机 (stereo camera) 就能做精细的双臂操作。EyeRobot 2.0 会像人一样，通过转动两个眼睛视角，把目光中心对准场景里的一个3D注视点。然后处理图像时，它采用中央凹处理 (foveally) 的方式，把更多的视觉token (visual tokens) 分配给图像中心，让计算集中在和任务相关的特征上。这种主动视觉注视 (Active Visual Fixation, AVF) 需要在执行任务时非常协调地控制目光，我们是用分层的方式做到的：先训练一个低级的注视伺服策略 (gaze servoing policy)，它根据目标物体来决定怎么转动眼睛；然后再训练一个目标选择器 (target selector)，它根据任务进展发出注视目标。这两个模块都是用强化学习 (RL) 在真实世界数据上训练的：第一个用密集几何奖励 (dense geometric reward) 训练，第二个和行为克隆 (BC) 夹爪策略 (gripper policy) 一起训练，这样它就能发现一些注视序列，这些序列在做任务时很像人类的注视顺序。EyeRobot 2.0 还进一步利用注视，把夹爪信息规范化到一个相对于注视的 SE(3) 坐标系 (SE(3) frame) 里，这样就能压缩需要学习的动作分布的大小。我们收集了7个真实世界任务和6个模拟任务的遥操作数据 (teleoperation data)，然后做了超过1000次真实机器人和1800次模拟机器人试验，把 EyeRobot 2.0 和用同样数据训练出来的被动立体相机 (passive stereo) 策略以及自我中心+手腕相机 (ego + wrist camera) 策略进行比较。对标准策略来说，拿掉手腕相机代价很大：如果只用被动立体相机，真实世界的成功率会从52%掉到27%。EyeRobot 2.0 只用立体相机就把这个差距补上了，在真实环境里比被动立体相机高出40%，在模拟环境里高出20%。当手腕视角清晰时，它能赶上自我中心+手腕策略（69% 对 64%），而当抓着的物体挡住手腕相机时，它的成功率是后者的两倍多（48% 对 22%）。

articles.title: Language Models that Play Chess and Explain Their Moves
articles.zh: 会下棋并能解释走法的语言模型
articles.summary: 如果你想拿棋类当LLM推理能力的试金石，重点不在它赢不赢，而在它的解释是否真的对应了它的决策
articles.author: Adithya Bhaskar, Jeffrey Cheng 等
articles.body: Modern chess engines are silent experts: they play at a superhuman level, but do not offer explanations for their play. On the other hand, language models (LMs) can generate plausible-sounding explanations, but their weak playing strength limits the utility of their explanations. We introduce Queen, a 4B-parameter chess-language model that can explain its moves and plans while playing at the level of a typical Grandmaster. Our novel framework enables domain-specific reasoning through complementary components: an encoder-decoder architecture and an iterative distillation algorithm. This architecture integrates a silent expert chess encoder with an instruction-tuned LM through cross-attention, which we train via a question-answering curriculum to extract chess concepts from the encoder's representations. Building on this domain-adapted model, we iteratively improve its explanations with a natural-language analog of the Bellman update: the model analyzes the positions after its top candidate moves and consolidates them into an explanation of the current position, which is then distilled back into the model. Over seven iterations, our model gains over 900 Elo points (1782 to 2697), substantially surpassing all frontier models on both playing strength and puzzle accuracy, despite containing three orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Furthermore, LM-based evaluations show that our explanations are fluent and approach GPT-5.6-Sol (high) in coherence. The generality of our architecture and training procedure suggests a recipe for applying language models to domains where silent expert encoders are available, like games, robotics, and computer use.
articles.bodyZh: 现代国际象棋引擎（chess engines）都是沉默的高手：棋力超人，可不会解释自己为什么这么下。另一边，语言模型（language models，简称 LMs）能生成听起来挺像回事的解释，但棋力太弱，解释也就没多大用。我们推出 Queen，一个 40 亿参数（4B）的国际象棋语言模型（chess-language model），它下棋能到普通特级大师（Grandmaster）的水平，同时还能解释自己的走法和计划。我们这套新框架靠几个互补组件，实现了特定领域推理（domain-specific reasoning）：一个是编码器-解码器架构（encoder-decoder architecture），另一个是迭代蒸馏算法（iterative distillation algorithm）。这个架构通过交叉注意力（cross-attention），把沉默的专家级国际象棋编码器和经过指令微调的语言模型（instruction-tuned LM）接到一起；我们用一个问答课程（question-answering curriculum）来训练它，从编码器表征（encoder's representations）里提取国际象棋概念。在这个领域适配模型的基础上，我们用一种自然语言版的贝尔曼更新（Bellman update）来反复改进它的解释：模型会分析它最优候选走法之后的局面，再把这些分析整合成对当前局面的解释，然后把这个解释蒸馏回模型里。经过七轮迭代，我们的模型涨了 900 多 Elo 分（Elo points）（从 1782 到 2697），在棋力和谜题准确率（puzzle accuracy）上都大幅超过所有前沿模型（frontier models），尽管参数量少了三个数量级。此外，基于语言模型的评测显示，我们的解释很流畅，连贯性也接近 GPT-5.6-Sol (high)。我们这套架构和训练流程的通用性，也给了一个可复用的方法：只要某个领域有沉默的专家编码器可用——比如游戏（games）、机器人（robotics）、电脑操作（computer use）——就能把语言模型用上去。

articles.title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
articles.zh: 融合转录组信息的多模态AI：从乳腺癌活检预测新辅助治疗响应
articles.summary: 如果你关注AI+医疗落地，这篇的价值在于把转录组这类高信息密度数据接进多模态预测，而不是只堆病理图像
articles.author: Jungkyu Park, Dhruva Biswas 等
articles.body: Scarcity of labeled data limits development of deep learning biomarkers in oncology. We develop a two-stage AI model predicting pathological complete response (pCR) to neoadjuvant therapy in breast cancer. The first stage learns the transcriptome from histopathology using 8,742 patients across 32 cancer types, corroborated by pathologist review and spatial agreement with measured expression. This simplifies the second stage to predicting pCR from inferred expression and clinical variables. Developed using 1,080 patients (five cohorts) and evaluated in 1,412 patients (nine cohorts), the model achieves a pooled AUROC of 0.79 (95% CI, 0.73-0.85), discriminating responders within molecular subtypes. It outperforms histopathological biomarkers, remaining stable across intratumoral sampling and with minimal biopsy tissue. Ablations show transcriptome-wide inference improves discrimination over clinical variables alone or one-stage pathology models, and robustness by avoiding genomic assays' gene selection constraints. These results indicate that biologically informed compression may generalize to data-sparse applications in precision oncology.
articles.bodyZh: 标注数据（labeled data）太少，是肿瘤学（oncology）里深度学习生物标志物（deep learning biomarkers）发展的一大瓶颈。我们做了一个两阶段AI模型（two-stage AI model），专门预测乳腺癌（breast cancer）患者对新辅助治疗（neoadjuvant therapy）会不会达到病理完全缓解（pathological complete response, pCR）。第一阶段用横跨32种癌症、8742名患者的组织病理（histopathology）数据，从里面学习转录组（transcriptome），还用病理医生复核（pathologist review）和实测表达（measured expression）的空间一致性（spatial agreement）来做佐证。这样一来，第二阶段就简化成：根据推断出的表达和临床变量（clinical variables），直接预测pCR。模型用1080名患者（5个队列，cohorts）开发，又在1412名患者（9个队列）里做评估，合并AUROC（pooled AUROC）达到0.79（95%置信区间，95% CI：0.73-0.85），还能在不同分子亚型（molecular subtypes）里分辨出有反应的人。它比组织病理生物标志物（histopathological biomarkers）表现更好，而且不管肿瘤内取样（intratumoral sampling）怎么变、哪怕只有很少的活检组织（biopsy tissue），结果都挺稳。消融实验（ablations）显示，做全转录组范围的推断（transcriptome-wide inference），比单用临床变量或一阶段病理模型更能区分出反应者；它还避开了基因组检测（genomic assays）里的基因筛选限制（gene selection constraints），所以更稳健。这些结果说明，这种带生物学信息的压缩方法（biologically informed compression），也许能推广到精准肿瘤学（precision oncology）里那些数据稀缺的应用场景。

articles.title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
articles.zh: FrugalEvo：面向成本感知的LLM引导程序进化
articles.summary: 如果你在跑LLM自动改代码的进化流程，这篇提醒你算力账单也是目标函数的一部分，别只盯着性能涨没涨
articles.author: Hui Chen, Xuan Qi 等
articles.body: LLM-guided evolutionary methods, such as AlphaEvolve, have emerged as powerful approaches for challenging computational optimization problems, such as circle packing. However, prior work typically optimizes performance gain over a fixed number of iterations. We argue that practical optimization should maximize gain per unit cost. To this end, we propose FrugalEvo, a cost-aware evolutionary framework where a stronger, higher-cost LLM explores solution strategies, and a cheaper LLM implements them and iteratively refines the resulting code. We also design a cache-efficient evolution process, where our harness and prompts maximize the sharing of prefixes across different evolution steps, to improve cache reuse. To measure solution quality throughout a fixed cost budget, we introduce Budget-Aware Area Under the Curve (BA-AUC), defined as the area under the best-so-far evaluation score curve over cumulative LLM cost, up to the budget. Across 10 mathematical and systems optimization tasks, FrugalEvo matches or surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, including OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve, AdaEvolve, and EvoX, in final solution quality and achieves higher BA-AUC on 9 tasks. It also achieves higher average performance than these baselines on 10 algorithmic optimization tasks from ALE-Bench-Lite. Notably, on circle packing, FrugalEvo achieves new state-of-the-art performance with GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna for only 1.68 USD and with GLM-5.3 and its Flash variant for only 0.55 USD, matching or surpassing all baselines, including multi-agent methods such as CORAL and SwarmResearch, which cost approximately 50 USD on average.
articles.bodyZh:
大语言模型引导的进化方法，比如AlphaEvolve，已经成为攻克圆形填充这类高难度计算优化问题的强大手段。但之前的研究通常只看固定迭代次数下能带来多少性能提升。我们认为，实际优化应该追求单位成本下的最大收益。

为此，我们提出了FrugalEvo，一个成本感知的进化框架：让一个更强、更贵的大语言模型去探索解题策略，再用一个更便宜的大语言模型去实现这些策略，并迭代优化生成的代码。我们还设计了一套缓存高效的进化流程，通过我们的工具和提示词，让不同进化步骤之间尽量共享前缀，提高缓存复用率。

为了在固定成本预算下衡量解决方案的质量，我们引入了预算感知曲线下面积（BA-AUC）这个指标，定义是在预算范围内，最佳评估得分随累计大语言模型成本变化的曲线下面积。在10个数学和系统优化任务上，FrugalEvo在最终解的质量上追平或超过了最先进的基线方法，包括OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve、AdaEvolve和EvoX，并且在9个任务上取得了更高的BA-AUC。在ALE-Bench-Lite的10个算法优化任务上，它的平均表现也优于这些基线。

特别值得一提的是，在圆形填充问题上，FrugalEvo用GPT-5.6 Terra和Luna只花了1.68美元就达到了新的最先进水平，用GLM-5.3及其Flash版本更是只花了0.55美元，追平或超过了所有基线方法，包括CORAL和SwarmResearch这类多智能体方法——而这些方法的平均花费大约要50美元。

articles.title: Pivot-SD: Efficient Self-Distillation for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.zh: Pivot-SD：面向掩码扩散语言模型的高效自蒸馏
articles.summary: 如果你在训练扩散式语言模型嫌收敛慢，这个自蒸馏路子能省下不少算力，但得接受它是个训练技巧而非新架构
articles.author: Seo Hyun Kim, Sunwoo Hong 等
articles.body: Masked diffusion language models (dLMs) offer a promising parallel alternative to autoregressive models for complex reasoning. However, they face a distinct credit-assignment challenge, since a few commitments during denoising sharply reduce the uncertainty over the remaining masked positions and shape much of the response. Most post-training recipes for dLMs do not use this signal to decide which tokens to train on: they typically train on the final text or assign rewards to whole denoising steps, rather than selecting the individual commitments that shape the response. We introduce Pivot-SD, an efficient offline self-distillation framework that supervises only these high-impact commitments (pivots). Pivot-SD selects pivots using an information-gain metric measuring uncertainty reduction over the remaining masked positions. Pivots from successful trajectories are trained with cross-entropy, and pivots from failed trajectories with targeted unlikelihood, leaving the rest of the failed trajectory untouched. Using only 200 questions and four rollouts each, Pivot-SD improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct over full-sequence SFT and budget-matched diffusion RL baselines across math and code benchmarks.
articles.bodyZh: 掩码扩散语言模型（masked diffusion language models, dLMs）给复杂推理提供了一条很有前景的并行路线，可以跟自回归模型（autoregressive models）掰掰手腕。但它们遇到一个很特别的“功劳分配”（credit assignment）难题：去噪（denoising）过程中，少数几个拍板式的选择，会一下子把剩下那些还被遮住的位置的不确定性大幅压低，并且很大程度上决定最终回答长什么样。大多数 dLM 的后训练（post-training）方案，并没有拿这个信号来决定该用哪些 token（词元）来训练：它们通常直接拿最终文本训练，或者把奖励发给整个去噪步骤，而不是挑出那些真正塑造回答的单个关键选择。我们提出 Pivot-SD，一个高效的离线自蒸馏（offline self-distillation）框架，只监督这些高影响力的关键拍板点（pivots）。Pivot-SD 用一个信息增益（information-gain）指标来挑 pivots，这个指标衡量的是：剩下那些还被遮住的位置，不确定性到底降了多少。成功轨迹（trajectories）里的 pivots 用交叉熵（cross-entropy）来训练，失败轨迹里的 pivots 则用定向不似然（targeted unlikelihood）来训练，失败轨迹的其余部分不动。只用 200 道题，每题 4 次 rollout（推演采样），Pivot-SD 就让 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 在数学和代码基准（benchmarks）上，比全序列监督微调（full-sequence SFT）和预算匹配的扩散强化学习（diffusion RL）基线（baselines）都更强。
